meta.description: Seven ways to work together. Each one starts from a business problem, not a technology.

title: <this>This</this> is what I can build for you.
lead: Seven ways to work together. Each one starts from a business problem, not a technology.

own.title: Your accounts stay yours.
own.text: Domains, stores, payment methods and business accounts belong to you. I work with the access I need, and nothing more.

final.title: Not sure which one you need?

cloud.title: Cloud-based
cloud.text: Operates through cloud infrastructure, allowing centralized access and management according to the solution's design.
cloud.label: Cloud services connected to several clients

local.title: Local deployment
local.text: Operates within your local infrastructure. It can be designed to work without permanent internet connectivity, when the architecture and requirements allow it.
local.label: Computers and a local server on an internal network

hybrid.title: Hybrid deployment
hybrid.text: Combines local infrastructure and cloud services. Depending on the design, it can include local processing, cloud backups, synchronization, remote management and centralized reporting.
hybrid.label: Local infrastructure connected to cloud services

deploy.note: These are architectural alternatives, not three features of every system. Offline operation, synchronization and remote access depend on the architecture selected for each project.
